Split the vanilla pod and scrape the seeds into a pan with the cream. Toss the pod in too. Heat until just before the cream boils, tiny bubbles will be forming at the edges. Turn off the heat and infuse for 15 mins. Step 2 Divide the raspberries between the ramekins, reserving a few. Whisk the egg yolks and caster sugar, until very pale and fluffy, about 3 mins. Remove the vanilla pod from the cooled cream, then slowly stir it into the egg mixture. Transfer to a jug and pour into the ramekins, then top with the reserved raspberries. Place ramekins into a tray with water about halfway up the sides. Bake in the oven for 20-25 mins until the custard forms a skin and holds a slight wobble when you nudge the tray. Allow to cool, then chill in the fridge for at least 4 hrs. Step 4 If you don’t have a blowtorch, heat the grill to high. Sprinkle sugar over each ramekin in an even layer and either use a blowtorch to caramelise the top or place them under the grill until the sugar has melted and crisped. All you need are mini muffin tins and the following ingredients:  Ingredients for pastry:  3 oz cream cheese (room temp) 1/2 cup unsalted butter (room temp) 1 cup flour Pinch of salt  Ingredients for pecan filling:  1 egg  3/4 cup brown sugar  1 Tbsp unsalted butter (room temp) 1 tsp vanilla  2/3 cup pecan crumbles  Pinch of salt  Directions for pastry:  1. Blend cream cheese and butter together until smooth.  2. Stir in flour & salt. Knead crumbly dough into a ball.  3. Chill dough for 20 minutes. Once chilled, form about 18 balls and place in your mini muffin tin (press dough firmly down, forming an indent enough to place filling)  Directions for filling:  1. Beat eggs, sugar, butter, vanilla and salt until smooth.  2. Split your pecan amount in half and add half to the filling mixture. 3. Add filling to the top the dough cups.  4. Top the cups with the remaining pecans.  Bake at 325 for around 25 minutes. Let cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Enjoy! #KrogerPartner #KrogerHolidays #ChristmasCookies #ChristmasCookieRecipe
